theorem_title: Nonempty switch choices at every reporting-bank level
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLevels.candidates_nonempty {h J k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.LightSwitchDepth.depth J) :
    (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Switch.candidates J k (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLevels.residual h J k)).Nonempty := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $h,J,k\in\mathbb N$, with $k$ at most the prescribed terminal reporting depth for $J$ blocks. For the residual parameter $r(h,J,k)$ of the shared reporting bank, the finite family of switching candidates is nonempty: $$\mathcal C(J,k,r(h,J,k))\ne\varnothing.$$

Makes the finite switching selection available at each constructed reporting level. This is a supporting lemma in the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
